messages.subject: Exploring a Technology Delivery Partnership | ZealInfy - AZWebCorp
messages.body:
Hi AZWebCorp Team,

I’m Praveen Reddy R., CEO of ZealInfy Software Pvt Ltd.

Your Arizona-based development model stood out because you explicitly support designers and agencies with overflow capacity and white-label delivery while staying invisible behind their brand.

At ZealInfy, we are looking to establish select long-term technology delivery partnerships with complementary US providers.

We bring AI Agents & Agentic AI, OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, LLM & RAG, intelligent automation, document intelligence, C#/.NET, React, Angular, Python/FastAPI, REST APIs, SaaS/custom applications and Microsoft Azure.

We can support AZWebCorp through white-label delivery, project-based delivery, engineering overflow, AI implementation, co-delivery and ongoing monthly engineering support.

Our objective is straightforward: Help AZWebCorp take on more opportunities without turning away work because of engineering capacity or specialized technical requirements.

We are comfortable with NDA, white-label arrangements and client protection, and can start with a suitable project or small pilot.

Would you be open to a short 15–20 minute conversation to explore this further?

Best regards,
Praveen Reddy R. | ZealInfy - CEO
ZealInfy Software Pvt Ltd.
